title: Smoky Monkfish Pilaf
description: A hearty German-inspired pilaf dish featuring smoky monkfish, perfect for a dinner option.

ingredients.name: Turkish Pilaf Rice
ingredients.notes: Use pre-cooked or cook according to package

ingredients.name: Salt and Pepper
ingredients.notes: Season with salt and pepper to taste

ingredients.name: Fresh Parsley
ingredients.notes: Garnish with parsley for a fresh touch

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the monkfish with salt, pepper, and smoky paprika.
Add the monkfish to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until cooked through.
Remove the monkfish from the skillet and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Add the chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Stir in the cooked pilaf rice and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until heated through.
Add the cooked monkfish back into the skillet and stir to combine with the pilaf.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
